visualCharacteristics.purpose: Slider of items with an optional heading row; the Style option picks the treatment
visualCharacteristics.description: instruments: dark stage with overlay panel and thumbnail rail flanked by prev/next arrows. split: single item as image beside a text panel with specs. resources: row of filter pills built from the authored filter labels, 3-up card slider (background image, category eyebrow, title, CTA button), dot pagination; clicking a pill filters cards by category, clicking it again clears.

contentPattern.structure: row 0 = heading/config (rich text; resources: a bulleted list of filter labels, plus optional heading); rows 1..N = one slide each: image cell + rich text cell (resources: first paragraph = category matching a filter label, heading = title, trailing link paragraph = CTA)

usage: Home and About Us pages (instruments, split); Host Response to Infection Educational Resources section (resources).
reuseGuidance: Use resources for filterable resource/news card sliders. Use cards-grid for static grids that need no paging or filtering.
